blockers.details: Current packet is ready for candidate normalization planning, not runtime integration.
Stage 1 variants, stage 2 branches, stages 3-5 segment assembly/reversal, stage 7 mainline/access split and stage 8 two child GPX components plus connectors must be implemented before route import.
Protected-area overlays must be run against final normalized geometry before rule attribution.
Transit schedules, fire bans, forestry notices, business hours, bathing-water status, water reliability and shelter maintenance are runtime checks.

openDecisions.decision: Decide app scope for optional businesses and off-route town services.
openDecisions.whyItMatters: Several services are useful but not core trail facilities; coordinate verification effort depends on the chosen scope.

openDecisions.decision: Confirm whether Rankåsleden and regional long-distance connections should be exposed in this import pass or kept as future connector metadata.
openDecisions.whyItMatters: The research says Rankåsleden is not an official numbered Västra Vätterleden stage.

openDecisions.decision: Approve candidate-only geometry prototype scope before any shared runtime source data is touched.
openDecisions.whyItMatters: The research packet explicitly says runtime import has not been performed.

validationChecklist: JSON parse this handoff and every changed research file.
Verify all 8 expected section files exist and are represented in importOrder/geometryPlan.
Confirm stage 1 and stage 2 primary/alternate geometry metadata survives normalization.
Confirm stages 3-5 segment assembly/reversal produces expected endpoints before facility snapping.
Confirm stage 7/8 continuous handoff uses Gagnån and keeps Fagerhult as access connector metadata.
Confirm Etapp 8 stays one official section with two child geometry components.
Run protected-area overlays after final geometry normalization.
Verify Hjoåns dalgång firepoint remains suppressed or pending unless a legal exception is proven.
Verify natural water is not imported as potable water without managed-source evidence.
Recheck transit, fire bans, forestry, business hours, bathing-water status, shelter maintenance and water currentness before runtime publication.
